features.name: odor_non_neutral_intensity
features.description: Maps odor code to non-neutral scent intensity: none is 0.0, almond or anise is 0.2, foul, fishy, or spicy is 0.75, and pungent, creosote, musty, or unseen odor codes are 1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense ordinal odor axis that lets the linear margin separate neutral, pleasant, and strong-scent profiles without many sparse indicators.

features.name: spore_print_salience_score
features.description: Maps spore print color to visual salience: black or brown is low, buff, orange, purple, or yellow is moderate, white is high, and chocolate, green, or unseen codes are maximal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses spore print codes into an interpretable color-salience axis, reducing reliance on individual one-hot terms.

features.name: gill_compaction_score
features.description: Weighted narrow-and-crowded gill geometry score using gill size and gill spacing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes two gill geometry fields into a continuous compaction measure that can receive one SVM weight.

features.name: gill_color_salience_score
features.description: Ordinal salience of gill hue, with white, red, or yellow low, pink or purple moderate, brown or gray high, and buff, black, chocolate, green, orange, or other codes maximal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordered hue-intensity projection for gill color, useful as a smooth linear cue.
